raw: Zhiqiang Que received the B.S. degree in micro- electronics and the M.S. degree in CS from Shanghai Jiao Tong University in 2008 and 2011, respectively, and the Ph.D. degree from the Department of Com- puting, Imperial College London, U.K., in 2023. He worked on microarchitecture design and verifi- cation of ARM CPUs with Marvell Semiconductor (2011-2015) and low latency FPGA systems with CFFEX (2015-2018). He is currently a Research Associate with the Department of Computing, Impe- rial College London. His research interests include computer architectures, embedded systems, high-performance computing, and computer-aided design tools for hardware design optimization.
